title: Last call for the metro
summary: Take the elevator down and catch a train across the city—or miss it and wait for the next one.
notes: Add four shared metro stations with elevators connecting public travel zones.
Run scheduled five-car trains with boarding countdowns, working doors and visible departures.
Let passengers move through furnished cars while tunnel lights and rail sounds accompany each ride.
Add metro directions to GPS and preserve existing destination access rules.
